draft_en.subject: A neutral-brand PoE line under Ruijie, Maipu and Allied Telesis
draft_en.body:
Hello Deponet team,

Alongside the Ruijie, Maipu and Allied Telesis switches you distribute, a neutral-brand line for the price-sensitive end of your reseller base, CE/RoHS, from small lots: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x Gigabit + 4 x 10G SFP+ L2+ - STC-424XGGM - $127.4; industrial mini Gigabit media converter - STI-110GE - $26.5.

One question: which PoE size do your resellers order most - 8, 16 or 24 ports?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
